description: This file defines a custom exception class 'TemplateForbiddenException' which extends 'AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException', used to represent a forbidden access error for a template URL in the application.

classes.name: TemplateForbiddenException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a template URL is forbidden or not allowed.

methods.name: TemplateForbiddenException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific error message indicating the URL that is forbidden.
